**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:9717)

**Proposed mechanism:** PEX2 (HGNC:9717) —DISRUPTS→ Peroxisome Assembly (GO:0000422); Peroxisome Assembly (GO:0000422) —DECREASES→ Very Long Chain Fatty Acids (CHEBI:35720); Very Long Chain Fatty Acids (CHEBI:35720) —LEADS_TO→ Hepatomegaly (HP:0002269); Very Long Chain Fatty Acids (CHEBI:35720) —LEADS_TO→ Cerebral dysgenesis (HP:0012370). Loss-of-function mutations in PEX2 disrupt peroxisome assembly, leading to impaired metabolism of very long chain fatty acids and subsequent accumulation, which contributes to hepatomegaly and cerebral dysgenesis.

**How to falsify it:** Demonstration of a gain-of-function mutation in PEX2 causing either disease, or identification of distinct, non-overlapping molecular pathways for each disease. _(variant: rs74617077 (c.407G>A, p.Gly136Glu) in PEX2 is present in gnomAD with an allele frequency > 0.01, suggesting it may not be a rare causal variant for severe phenotypes.)_
